name: Policy fidelity
judge_instructions: Every policy fact the reply states (return window, restocking fee percentage, who pays return shipping) matches the policy text. Fail if any stated fact contradicts the policy.

name: Refund calculation
judge_instructions: The refund amount the reply gives is exactly correct to the cent for this order under the policy (restocking fee charged on the item price for opened, non-defective items; return label deducted unless defective or shipping is free).

name: No unsupported promises
judge_instructions: The reply does not offer anything the policy rules out (store credit, gifts, discounts, shipping upgrades). Promises the policy does provide, such as a prepaid label for a defective item, are fine.

name: Professional tone
judge_instructions: The reply is courteous and does not blame, lecture or talk down to the customer.
